# GitHub collaboration files

[Ownership](OWNERSHIP.md) routes reviews by role. [Feature](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md) and [bug](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.md) templates capture actionable issues. The [pull request template](pull_request_template.md) records scope and evidence. [Workflow plan](workflows/README.md) defines future automation; it is not an executable workflow.

Create a real CODEOWNERS file only after GitHub handles and access are confirmed. A repository administrator configures review requirements and protected branches separately.
